title: obra/superpowers: a skills workflow that makes coding agents plan first
friendlyTitle: Superpowers makes coding agents plan before they write code
summary: Superpowers is a skills framework that tells a coding agent to agree a design, write a plan, and then work through tasks with review, including test-first development. It supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Hermes and other agents. It was the third-highest new AI-related repository on today's trending list, with about 688 stars today and about 299,700 overall.
friendlySummary: Superpowers is a set of skills that asks a coding agent to agree a design and a plan before it builds. It works with several coding agents. It gained about 688 stars today.
whyItMatters: You can use it to stop an agent from writing code before you have approved a short plan. An optional visual companion loads a logo that reports the Superpowers version; set SUPERPOWERS_DISABLE_TELEMETRY if you do not want that.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it when you want a plan you can read before the agent starts coding. You can turn off its optional version check if you do not want that request.
